Name: Ilyeana's Bus Stop Fix for CP (SVE Compatible)
Author: IlyeanaPlus
Description:
The Bus Stop has been improved  - helpful for players who are compelled to decorate-all-the-things, and casual gamers who hate tripping on rocks.

[b][u]CHANGES:[/u][/b]
- Removed pebbles which obstructed some movement & building
- Shifted the signpost off the path.
- Modified Abigail's schedule to make her less erratic and destructive (Sorry Abby!)

[b]*****VERSION 1.2.0 is compatible with SVE / RSV as it does NOT replace a map. All edits are done with json in Content Patcher.******[/b]
- Please note that SVE/RSV NPCs do not have their paths changed at the moment.

[u]I use mods from my favourite creators in some of my screenshots! They include:[/u]
- DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour
- Gwen's Paths (Gweniaczek)
- Fruit Smoothie Recolors
- Fairy Garden Furniture Pack (Hime & Flour) 
- Greenhouse Furniture (Hime & Flour)
[i]Please check out their mods here on Nexus![/i]
